After reading the reviews on this masque, it appeared that my hair was going to smell great, feel soft, and look smooth and shiny. Well, when it arrived, I used it the same day and I did see many results that I loved. My hair was definitely a lot softer, smoother, and less frizzy after using this. So that is absolutely true. Th

reviews.t: Why is this product like this?
reviews.x: I just got the order like just now. I am not sure if its supposed to have like a product protection seal. It's like its already open and a chunk was taken out.
I recieved this product and it looked like someone had already used it.

I used this last night it just arrived and my hair is so soft and shiny! I have so much volume! My cousin was raving over it.  She gave me the website and I'm an Amazon lover, so I looked it up on here.  I'm so happy I did.  It's more affordable and even received a discount. The best hair mask ever! You'll love it! Please do not use a lot! It takes a very small amount to do your entire hair!

This stuff is incredible! I have used it only twice, once a week for the last 2 weeks and my hair has went from feeling like straw to super soft and shiny and way more manageable! You don't need much because it's super thick and creamy, a little goes a long way. So happy with this purchase and will continue to buy, highly recommend!

Like everything about this. I’ve seen a considerable improvement to my dry, damaged, color treated, heat styled, over processed hair. Getting some regrowth to some severe breakage and keeps my hair more manageable and less frizzy.

reviews.t: My hair feels amazing but the scent is a no for me
reviews.x: This product makes my hair so silky and shiny. I love the results however I HATE the scent. It smells awful to me. Like perfume trying to cover up cigarette smoke. It is so strange.

I tried this conditioner, followed the directions on the jar. My hair came out soo soft and silky. I could comb right throught it. It smelled great too. I think my hair was too soft, as it did not want to hold a curl lol. I was very satisfied with this conditioner. I will use once a week to get amazing softness and great smelling hair. I would recommend using this conditioner. All the L'ange products have been my daily hair must have.

I had bought myself a  heat cap for my hair because my hair is dry and it has really been thinning since I started becoming middle aged. My sister gave me this deep condition protein  hair mask a few months ago to try. I have been using it once a week and my hair is definitely a lot softer and shinier. The one thing that really sticks out is the smell, it is very pleasant and not over powering.

This product left my hair so silky smooth and shiny. Great slip and no tangles. I only drop the rating down a star because some of the ingredients will cause build up over time but if you only use every once in a while and occasionally use a clarifying or ant residue shampoo you should be fine.

reviews.t: This makes your hair So Soft without weighing it down!!
reviews.x: My hair is dry and damaged from coloring my hair so much and this product is such a life saver!! It also smells Amazing!!! It leaves my hair So Soft without weighing it down and it looks and feels so much healthier!!! So worth every penny!!!

From the very moment I put it on my hair, I feel how it softens knots and I can just untangle my haif with my fingers. It’s crazy good.  I’m not fond of the perfume as it’s very strong.  I keep on trying other stuff with great reviews here on Amazon, different forums and even Tiktok. But this hair mask works best on my hair,

This deep conditioning treatment actually worked for me, and I saw a noticeable different after 1 use. If you're considering buying this... Go for it! Highly recommend.

I really wanted to love this product. I was not impressed. I have used other products that left my hair feeling better for less money. Joico makes a great deep conditioning product and my go to before highlights, It’s a 10 intensive conditioning treatment

I use this product as a leave in conditioner.  Just the tiniest amount and my hair is soft and no frizz. I have straight fine oily hair that is bleached but with this product my hair is not weighed down it doesn’t get knotted up,  I just love it!
I used it for the first time and it left my hair so soft. I really like it. You don’t have to leave it on for long to see results. It’s recommended to use it once a week which I will start doing.
This is the best hair mask I’ve ever used. It makes my hair soft and manageable. I use it regularly so I hope they don’t stop making it.

I’m sorry but you CAN BUY ALL THESE PRODUCTS FROM L’ange on sale for $10 wth!

claims.text: Most reviewers say the mask leaves hair noticeably softer, silkier, and shinier.
Several reviewers with dry, damaged, or color-treated hair report improved manageability and reduced frizz.
A few reviewers received products that appeared already opened or used.
Opinions on scent are mixed, with some loving it and others disliking it.
Some reviewers note the product is thick and a little goes a long way, though one warns of buildup over time.
